## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmed by Financials and Healthcare leadership (MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership is narrow and tech-biased (Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY; NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND) — style: Growth/Momentum with notable 1W/1M divergences.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing strong 1W breadth with PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY; Financials show breadth and momentum with MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy and Real Estate lag: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND; DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY; NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY; APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION; INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION; AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION; DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in telecom, select industrials and real estate.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY; NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present — multiple large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, etc.) show 1W vs 1M mismatches, so treat moves as tactical rather than fully confirmatory.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but active: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY are driving the sector; NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) is BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 16/24 positive — Internal Rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and broad: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND while JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) is in CORRECTION. Financials breadth: 14/20 positive — Sector Strength/participation supporting the RISK-ON call.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive-cyclical balance with conviction: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare breadth: 12/17 positive — Sector Strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Financials and selective Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND (MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND) and participate selectively in high-momentum Tech (PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to laggard Utilities and troubled Telecoms (VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND; T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND) and monitor the major 1W/1M divergences for trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND; APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (14/20 positive) and Healthcare (12/17 positive) on confirmed ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Utilities (3/10 positive) and Energy (3/10 positive) where multiple names are BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
PANW above near-term breakout to confirm continuation (PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND). AAPL support to watch during the RECOVERY bounce (AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY). QCOM needs to reclaim short-term trend to avoid further downside (QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (+60): MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY — OpenAI IPO linkage is confirming strong price action. JPM (+80): JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — buyback/dividend news supports structural strength but watch short-term fatigue. QCOM (+55): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — bullish supply-deal headline diverges from heavy price weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CEG (-50): CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND — target cut confirms price weakness. ADBE (-45): ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY — analyst concern contrasts with strong 1W move, watch for follow-through. TSLA (-45): TSLA (1W: +4.89% | 1M: -7.15%) RECOVERY — negative headlines create divergence vs short-term bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Growth/Momentum favored on narrow tech leadership but broad participation (Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive). PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) and several sentiment/price mismatches warrant monitoring for trend breaks.
